meta_description:
44K likes, 226 comments - thefitnesschef_ on October 5, 2026: "This high protein pulled lamb pasta salad needs to enter your life. 🥗 Here’s how to make it ⤴️

I slightly modified the quantities of ingredients to ensure each portion was higher in protein and lower in calories. Here’s the full recipe:

Ingredients (serves 2):
150g uncooked pasta
1 tbsp oregano
Salt & pepper
15ml olive oil
1 sliced red onion
1/2 chopped cucumber 
1/2 chopped red pepper
300g pulled lamb shoulder (most supermarkets offer precooked)
12 Kalamata olives 
75g tzatziki
Fresh dill
Fresh mint
75g crumbled feta

Method:
1. Add the pasta to a saucepan of boiling water and simmer for 6-8 mins until tender. Then rinse under cold water and drain.
2. Add the cooked pasta to a large mixing bowl, then add the oregano, salt, pepper, olive oil, red onion, red pepper, pulled lamb, Kalamata olives and tzatziki.
3. Mix thoroughly before topping with dill, mint and crumbled feta. Then serve!

Per portion:
Calories: 577
Protein: 42g
Carbs: 64g
Fat: 17g

Original recipe from: @poss.pantry 

#pasta #salad #worklunch".
